snippet.title: Bigfoot Is Real in GTA 6
snippet.description:
Bigfoot is in GTA 6, and he's based on a real legend from Florida 🦍

Follow Rotar 👇
▶️ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@rotartcg
🎵 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@rotartcg
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rotartcg
👍 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596450302287
𝕏 X: https://x.com/rotartcg
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/Cz6eXu5AdB

In GTA 6 he's called the Skunk Ape, Florida's own Bigfoot, which people have been reporting since the 1950s and which is said to smell like rotten eggs. You'll find him in the swamps south of Hamlet. Chase him and he leads you to a creepy figure on a tree, you black out, and he comes back to stand over you. There's even a side quest from a man named Kirk, who calls him Mr. Mangrove and pays you a $500 skunk ape hunter fee.

Do you think the real Skunk Ape is out there?

Sources: Florida Fish and Wildlife via ClickOrlando (3 May 2024), CBS Miami (17 Jun 2019), PowerPyx's GTA 6 guides.

The Skunk Ape is not a myth this time — early players found the full encounter south of Hamlet, and the feet cutscene is nightmare fuel.

Bigfoot is in GTA 6. Head to Cottonmouth Lake, just below Hamlet, right after the first mission: a deep growl marks the spot, a dead animal sits in the road, the creature bolts into the marsh, and deeper in the woods a vine effigy ringed with red flowers knocks Jason clean out — then those feet step into frame. You cannot catch him and bullets do not hurt him. Whether this is a one-off or step one of a longer easter egg is still unclear.

Footage: early launch-day player gameplay from an early-unlock region (New Zealand wave), captured by Lootward — this is not our gameplay and not an official Rockstar release. The source clip carries the uploader watermark.
Music: "HardHeadBang" by Monplaisir (CC0 — no attribution required; credit given as a courtesy).
Voiceover: Pause Menu.

Sources: GameRant, "Where to Find Bigfoot in GTA 6" (Nov 18, 2026) — https://gamerant.com/gta-6-bigfoot-location-where-to-find/

snippet.title: GTA 6 Players Found Bigfoot… And It's Terrifying
snippet.description:
GTA 6 has only been out for hours and players already found it: a hairy creature eating a deer on the swamp roads near Cottonmouth Lake. Bullets don't stop it. Follow it into the trees and you find a creepy tree effigy… then Jason blacks out, the creature's feet walk up to him, and he wakes up back in his car. In Leonida they call it the Skunk Ape, Florida's own Bigfoot.

Sources: Insider Gaming ("Where to find Bigfoot in GTA 6"), GamesRadar, GameSpot, Kotaku launch live blog, r/GTA6 and r/GTA player reports (Nov 18, 2026).
